fix(agent-pane): the summary card holds still while the chat scrolls (#29282)

cmux NEXT: the unread dot waits for an agent's background subagents (#25607)
cmux-tui: after a restart the owner answers at once; adoptions take turns, visible workspace first (perf100) (#24307)
cmux-tui: output's scroll events publish once per frame, not once per chunk (perf100) (#23179)
optchat-chief: Chief survives an update handoff while the old acpmux still holds its lock (#23019)
cmux NEXT: a keep quit ends within 4 s whatever any step does; Restart to Update never leaves cmux invisible (#22919)
EditCounts: keep one count per group, not every earlier prefix (#29368)

highlights.body: Agent chats and terminal tabs show their unread dot and finished notification when the task's background agents finish. Starting another turn keeps the dot waiting for that turn to finish.
highlights.title: Unread dots wait for background agents

highlights.body: Find common tab and pane actions faster in shorter menus. Hibernate/Wake Tab, terminal themes, column width, and docking remain in the command palette, and Show in Tab Bar lists controls for the selected tab.
